summary.text: Nabeela Syed is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives, representing District 51 since January 2023, and is the Democratic candidate for Illinois State Senate District 26 on November 3, 2026.
She is not running for re-election to the House seat.

paragraphs.text: Syed was born in Illinois and earned bachelor's degrees in business administration and political science from the University of California, Berkeley, in 2021.
Her career experience includes working as campaign manager for Township High School District 211 school board member Tim McGowan and in digital strategy for a nonprofit.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Syed said she had worked with EMILY's List to raise money to elect Democrats to Congress and had organized Asian American voters in Georgia.
Syed took office in the Illinois House on January 11, 2023, succeeding Chris Bos.
In the 2022 survey, she listed reproductive rights and property taxes among her campaign's key messages.
She advanced from the Democratic primary for the State Senate seat on March 17, 2026.
